privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.body_md:
# Privacy Policy

At PyNotes, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

### Information We Collect
We collect your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address when you place an order. We also collect usage data through cookies to improve our website.

### How We Use Your Information
Your information is used solely to process your orders, provide support, and send updates about our services.

### Data Security
We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Your payment information is handled securely by Razorpay and is never stored on our servers.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.body_md:
# Terms of Service

Welcome to PyNotes. By using our website, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.

### Use of Service
You agree to use PyNotes for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others.

### Intellectual Property
All content on this site, including handwritten notes, images, and logos, is the property of PyNotes and is protected by copyright laws.

### Limitation of Liability
PyNotes is not liable for any damages arising from the use of our products or website.

refund-policy.title: Return & Refund Policy
refund-policy.body_md:
# Return & Refund Policy

We want you to be satisfied with your purchase. If you receive a damaged or incorrect book, please follow these guidelines.

### Returns
You can request a return within 48 hours of delivery for damaged or wrong items. Please provide photo proof through your account dashboard.

### Refunds
Once your return is verified, we will initiate a refund to your original payment method. Razorpay refunds typically take 5-7 working days.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.body_md:
# Shipping Policy

We ship our printed books across India using express courier partners like Shiprocket and Bluedart.

### Processing Time
Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You will receive a tracking ID via email once shipped.

### Delivery Time
Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days depending on your location. Prepaid orders get priority express shipping.

cancellation-policy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation-policy.body_md:
# Cancellation Policy

### One-time Orders
You can cancel your book order anytime before it is shipped. Once shipped, the order cannot be cancelled.

### Subscriptions
You can cancel your subscription anytime through the 'My Account' page. If you cancel during the 7-day free trial, you will not be charged. Post-trial cancellations will stop the next recurring debit.
